In a recent development, né à Saint-Priest-en-Jarez et formé à L’Étrat dès l'âge de 8 ans, Maedine Makhloufi avait signé son premier contrat professionnel avec les Verts en mai 2025 avant de mettre le cap sur Dunkerque l'hiver dernier. Tout juste prêté au FC Villefranche Beaujolais (Ligue 3), le latéral gauche de 21 ans s'apprête à retrouver Geoffroy-Guichard dès ce samedi (19h) à l'occasion du 8e tour de la Coupe de France. Avant ces retrouvailles au goût forcément particulier, l'ancien protégé du centre de formation s'est confié en toute simplicité à Poteaux Carrés.

According to recent reports, maedine, tu es né à deux pas de L'Étrat, à Saint-Priest-en-Jarez, et tu as poussé les portes de l’ASSE à seulement 8 ans. Quel est ton premier souvenir de gamin en Vert ?

According to recent reports, mon tout premier souvenir, c'est lors de ma détection. J'arrivais de l'Olympique du Montcel, à La Ricamarie. On avait raté les détections pour la génération 2005, donc je les ai passées avec les 2006. À la fin, ils m'ont demandé si j'étais né en 2006, je leur ai répondu que j'étais de 2005 et ils m'ont dit de revenir le lendemain avec ma génération. Tout est parti de là. C’est un cousin qui m’avait emmené ce jour-là, il m'avait dit : « Tu vas venir t'entraîner ». À 8 ans, tu ne réalises pas vraiment où tu mets les pieds, j'étais juste venu jouer au foot et m'amuser.

Le foot, c'était déjà toute ta vie à cet âge-là ?

Industry observers note that oui, depuis tout petit. J'avais toujours un ballon avec moi, dès que je pouvais. En bas de chez moi, il y avait un stade, donc on passait notre temps là-bas avec mon grand frère, mes nombreux cousins et les potes du quartier.

Durant tes douze années au centre, y a-t-il un éducateur qui t'a plus marqué que les autres ?

Franchement, je n'en ai pas un en particulier qui ressort. Je n'ai croisé que de bonnes personnes, on a vraiment été très bien entourés, ils ont tous été magnifiques. Quand je suis arrivé à l'école de foot, on s'entraînait encore au stade à Méons, juste à côté de Geoffroy-Guichard. Puis en U12, on a basculé au centre de formation à L’Étrat, c'est devenu plus carré, plus cadré. Il y a eu des saisons plus compliquées que d'autres, mais j'ai franchi toutes les étapes jusqu'à la réserve et mon premier contrat pro. Je n'en garde que du positif.

Quels sont tes souvenirs les plus forts de toutes ces années de formation ?

Industry observers note that les derbies contre l'Olympique Lyonnais, sans hésiter ! Chaque week-end de derby, même quand on était tout petits, c'était magnifique, toute la semaine était spéciale. Et puis tous les tournois, les moments de vie entre coéquipiers, ce ne sont que des super souvenirs.

Le 28 mai 2025, tu signes ton premier contrat professionnel avec ton club formateur. Qu'est-ce qui se passe dans la tête d'un enfant du Forez à ce moment-là ?

C'est la récompense de tout le travail accompli. Avant tout, une immense fierté, pour moi mais surtout pour mes proches. On n'a pas fait de grosse fête particulière, mais tout le monde était heureux et j'ai senti que j'avais rendu ma famille fière.

Tu n'as pas paraphé ce contrat tout seul puisque Jules Mouton a signé le sien le même jour que toi. Vous vous êtes un peu chambrés ?

According to recent reports, non, parce qu'on le savait un petit peu avant. Jules est arrivé un an après moi, on a fait pratiquement tout notre parcours ensemble, donc arriver là main dans la main, c'était magnifique. On est restés très proches. Je garde d'ailleurs le contact avec la plupart des gars de la génération 2005 sur les réseaux. Avec Jules, on s'est même croisés en Ligue 2 cette saison puisqu'il joue à Grenoble, on a un peu rigolé avant le match.

Qu'est-ce qui a motivé ton départ vers Dunkerque au mercato d'hiver dernier ?

J'ai reçu un appel de Dunkerque et ça s'est fait très vite. À Saint-Étienne, je n'avais pas beaucoup de temps de jeu : je jouais en réserve mais pas du tout avec l'équipe première. C'était une belle opportunité pour moi, les deux clubs se sont mis d'accord sans aucun problème.

Après douze ans dans le cocon stéphanois, comment s'est passée ton intégration dans le Nord ?

In a recent development, super bien, franchement nickel. À Saint-Étienne, je m'étais déjà pas mal entraîné avec le groupe pro, donc rien qu'en observant les anciens, tu apprends vite. Et à Dunkerque, le groupe était jeune avec que des bons mecs. Bon, comme on est tout près de la mer, il y a souvent du vent, mais on s'y fait (rires) !

Recent findings suggest that là-bas, tu as choisi de porter le numéro 42. C'était un message subliminal pour dire que la Loire ne te quittait jamais ?

(Rires) Oui, c'était clairement un clin d'œil ! Comme je suis arrivé en cours de saison, il ne restait plus énormément de numéros libres et j'ai tout de suite sauté sur le 42. J'ai reçu plein de messages sympas de supporters stéphanois grâce à ça, et même dans le Nord, tout le monde savait à quoi ça correspondait !

According to recent reports, même si tu aurais aimé jouer davantage, tu as quand même eu le temps de marquer un but express en 4 minutes dans un derby face à Boulogne ! Qu'as-tu appris chez les Maritimes ?

C'était une sensation incroyable, mon premier but chez les pros et dans un derby en plus, tu ne peux pas rêver mieux ! Ces mois à Dunkerque m'ont fait basculer du monde semi-pro au monde pro. J'ai énormément appris sur les détails tactiques, l'exigence de concentration et l'impact physique. La réserve en N3 te prépare bien parce que tu affrontes des adultes, mais l'étage au-dessus, c'est encore un autre monde.

Tu viens tout juste de poser tes valises au FC Villefranche Beaujolais en prêt pour retrouver du rythme en Ligue 3. Passer de la mer du Nord aux vignes du Beaujolais, le choc climatique et gastronomique n'est pas trop rude ?

It has been revealed that (Rires) Non, franchement ça va très bien ! En plus, je me rapproche de la maison. Et puis dans le Beaujolais, on mange bien et on boit bien aussi, donc l'adaptation est facile.

Industry observers note that tu es arrivé lundi dernier à Villefranche, et le tirage au sort t'envoie directement dans le Chaudron ce samedi ! Tu as vérifié que la FFF n'avait pas truqué les boules juste pour ton histoire personnelle ?

C'est possible ça (rires) ! Non, plus sérieusement, c'est un scénario magnifique. J'ai déjà eu la chance de rejouer 5 ou 10 minutes à Geoffroy-Guichard avec Dunkerque la saison dernière, et revenir chez moi devant ma famille et mes amis, c'était quelque chose de fort. Ce samedi, mes proches seront encore en tribunes. Maintenant, je ne suis pas le coach, j'espère avant tout être dans le groupe et avoir du temps de jeu.

Pour les supporters stéphanois qui t'ont un peu perdu de vue, quel joueur es-tu devenu aujourd'hui dans ton couloir gauche ?

It has been revealed that J'ai beaucoup travaillé sur mes défauts depuis mon départ à Dunkerque, on avait ciblé certains points précis et je me suis accroché. J'ai gagné en expérience et en maturité, dans mon jeu comme en dehors. Aujourd'hui, je suis un joueur plus complet et plus fort.

Qu'est-ce qui te motive au quotidien quand tu te lèves pour aller à l'entraînement ?

Sources indicate that je me dis simplement que j'ai l'un des plus beaux métiers du monde ! Il y a plein de gens qui se lèvent tôt pour faire des boulots bien plus difficiles que le nôtre, donc on n'a vraiment pas le droit de se plaindre. Même s'il y a toujours des séances plus dures que d'autres, je vais à l'entraînement avec le sourire. Le jour où je ne prendrai plus de plaisir, j'arrêterai.

Parmi les jeunes du centre qui sont aujourd'hui dans le groupe pro stéphanois, lequel redoutes-tu le plus d'affronter samedi soir ?

It has been revealed that ils ont tous beaucoup de qualités, mais je pense forcément à Kevin Pedro. On a un an d'écart, on a énormément joué ensemble et on était très proches. Il fait une saison magnifique et ça ne m'étonne pas du tout : il a toujours été très fort et joue avec beaucoup d'intelligence. Tout ce qui lui arrive est amplement mérité.

Sources indicate that dernière question : imaginons qu'on joue la 89e minute samedi, qu'il y a toujours 0-0 et que tu te retrouves seul face au gardien vert. Tu vises la lucarne pour qualifier Villefranche ou tu rends hommage à notre site en frappant volontairement sur le poteau carré — même s'ils sont ronds aujourd'hui ?

In a recent development, (Éclat de rire) Je pense que je vais plutôt viser le filet ! Tant pis pour Poteaux Carrés.

According to recent reports, un grand merci à toi Maedine pour ta disponibilité. Toute l'équipe de Poteaux Carrés te souhaite le meilleur pour la suite et de pouvoir fouler la pelouse samedi… sans marquer si possible !

According to recent reports, merci beaucoup à vous ! Quel que soit le résultat, ce sera une belle fête. Sur un match de Coupe, l'écart entre une Ligue 2 et une Ligue 3 n'est pas si grand, tout reste possible.

L’edema è riassorbito e il capitano sarà convocato; Gattuso deciderà alla vigilia se schierarlo dall’inizio.

According to recent reports, mattia Zaccagni è tornato ad allenarsi con il gruppo e punta a giocare dal primo minuto contro il Torino, sabato alle 18. Secondo quanto riportato da Il Messaggero, Dopo due giorni di riposo, la Lazio si è ritrovata a Formello: il rientro del capitano è la buona notizia per la capolista guidata da Rino Gattuso.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

It has been revealed that zaccagni aveva svolto lavoro individuale domenica e lunedì. Ora spinge per essere in campo in Piemonte, ma il suo impiego sarà valutato giorno per giorno. il capitano sarà nella lista dei convocati; anche se non dovesse partire titolare, potrà giocare a partita in corso.

La prudenza dipende dalla natura dello stop. Davide Frattesi era stato rimandato a casa dal ritiro della Nazionale per un affaticamento; Zaccagni, invece, ha dovuto superare una lesione al quadricipite. Una nuova risonanza magnetica, effettuata la settimana scorsa, aveva mostrato un miglioramento dell’edema post-traumatico.

Adesso l’edema si è completamente riassorbito e il capitano è disponibile. La Lazio, però, non vuole correre rischi, anche in vista degli impegni di dicembre. Gattuso deciderà soltanto alla vigilia se utilizzarlo dall’inizio contro il Torino.

It has been revealed that anche Nuno Tavares guarda a un appuntamento preciso: il derby del 13 dicembre. Il portoghese procede lentamente e non ha ancora ripreso ad allenarsi con il gruppo. Per avvicinarsi al rientro dovrà accelerare il lavoro nei prossimi giorni.

Recent findings suggest that restano incerti i tempi di recupero di Marusic. Il problema nella zona del tendine, accusato durante il ritiro con il Montenegro, non consente ancora di stabilire quando tornerà. È il suo terzo stop stagionale. Sulla destra, intanto, Gattuso può contare su Floriani Mussolini e, come seconda soluzione, su Lazzari.

PSV and Feyenoord face an uphill task to reach the group stages of the Champions League after defeats on Tuesday night saw them drop out of the qualifying places.

According to recent reports, PSV briefly threatened to cause an upset in Madrid as they took a 1-0 lead into the half-time break. Ivan Perisic’s penalty after 32 minutes was their only reward for a courageous first-half display in which Ruben van Bommel and Sven Mijnans also missed clear chances to score.

Industry observers note that but the introduction of Jude Bellingham at half-time changed the picture as Real’s superstars regrouped to score five goals. The England midfielder’s dazzling volley was the pick of the bunch, while Kylian Mbappé bagged a double and Vinicius Junior also got on the scoresheet.

According to recent reports, head coach Peter Bosz admitted his team had been “trampled underfoot” in the second half. “I think you had to be there to see how major the difference was between the first and second half,” he said.

“In the first half we were brave, put our opponents under pressure and had three major chances in the first four minutes.

“When you look at the second half, they scored swiftly and the tempo of their game was much higher. That’s the quality they have with the players they can bring off the bench.”.

PSV’s next match is a home tie against Real’s city rivals Atletico on December 9, before they travel to Stavanger to take on Viking in January and round off the group stage at home to Stuttgart.

Feyenoord suffered a narrower defeat at home to Porto as they were unable to recover from an own goal after two minutes by Oussama Targhalline.

Goalkeeper Florian Kastenmeier vindicated the decision of Giovanni van Bronckhorst to replace the out-of-form Tjark Ernst by making some vital saves to keep the Rotterdammers in the game.

Feyenoord staged a late rally, with Gjivai Zechiël going close and Targhalline striking the crossbar from long range, but they were unable to breach the Portuguese side’s defence.

The fans in De Kuip were briefly celebrating after a bizarre incident when referee Irfan Peltjo’s watch told him a header by Nacho Ferri had crossed the line, but video replays clearly demonstrated it bounced off the post and into the hands of Diogo Costa.

Sources indicate that feyenoord have just three points from their five matches so far, one less than PSV. Their next two matches are away to Viking on December 8 and Galatasaray on January 19, before they close their campaign in Rotterdam against RB Leipzig.

Je ne pense pas que ce soit un relâchement dans le travail, peut-être un peu dans les têtes. Il faut remettre le bleu de chauffe. Ce n'est surtout pas le moment de partir en vrille, de commencer à chercher des coupables, de regarder le voisin de travers. 📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By TAMARA PRENN, SENIOR SPORTS REPORTER.

Published: 05:59 EST, 22 November 2026 | Updated: 10:11 EST, 23 November 2026.

Argentina star Leandro Paredes collapsed during a live interview immediately after winning a trophy with his Boca Juniors side.

The 32-year-old was one of the focal points of a World Cup side that reached the final last summer, and went on to win the Copa Sudamericana on Saturday evening after beating Brazil's Atletico Mineiro 2-0 in Barranquilla.

But amid the thick humidity and Colombian heat, Paredes became overwhelmed moments after lifting the trophy.

After giving a brief interview, Paredes was captured closing his eyes, before falling towards the interviewer, who attempted to break his fall.

Instead, the former Paris Saint-Germain midfielder hit the ground, with attendants rushing to help him after his collapse.

Paredes had been taken off in the second-half after suffering from heat-related dizziness, with humidity at 80 per cent heading into the match, and 32-degree-temperatures.

Leandro Parades collapsed to the floor during a post-match interview after winning the Copa Sudamericana with Boca Juniors.

The interviewer attempted to break his fall as the former PSG crumpled to the turf.

It has been revealed that 'He felt dizzy towards the end of the first-half,' his manager Rodolfo Arruabarrena explained of the substitution. 'He improved a little during the break, but after 10 minutes in the second-half, you could see he was struggling.'.

Fortunately, Paredes was revived quickly and treated in the treatment room, before re-joining his team's celebrations after claiming the South American trophy.

The star shared a brief statement on social media confirming he was fine after the interview aired.

'We're fine,' Paredes confirmed with a picture taken during treatment, before adding in a separate caption: 'Thanks to everyone for the messages, it was just a dizziness from so many turns together'.

Paredes' triumph for his club side comes months after agonising defeat to Spain in Latest York at the World Cup final in July.

Argentina were felled by a solitary goal from Ferran Torres to end their reign as world champions, before the match descended into petty scraps - with Paredes at the heart of the bad behaviour.

Paredes furiously shoved Spain substitute Gavi to the floor after the final whistle blew, earning himself a punchy 10-match suspension from FIFA.

He faced three assault charges, while teammate Nahuel Molina faced two, and both players were also fined $90,000 (£66,000).

Paredes himself admitted that the length of the ban had put his international future under consideration.

'It's going to be difficult for me to stay with the national team,' Paredes told the media in September. 'Because of the suspension as well, because of (Lionel Messi) Leo's decision. It's going to be difficult for everything to carry on as before.

'I haven't discussed it with the coach (Lionel Scaloni) yet, but we'll talk about it and see what decision I make.'.

Paredes' announcement came just days after Messi decided to hang up his international boots, with the talismanic Argentina superstar treated to a magnificent send-off during the early Autumn international break.

'Leo's legacy will live on forever because of what he achieved, for never giving up and for showing that dreams are hard-won, pursued and, in the end, fulfilled,' Paredes added.

Paredes updated fans after the incident to confirm he was okay before rejoining the festivities with his team-mates (Source: Instagram/Leandro Parades).

'We'd spoken in the final days of the World Cup about how the final would surely be his last match, but even so, we weren't prepared for that because of what he means to us.'.

Although unable to compete alongside him in their country's colours for one last time, Paredes joined Messi on the pitch in Buenos Aires for his final farewell, and shared an emotional tribute post to his former captain.

'THANK YOU FOR ABSOLUTELY EVERYTHING CAPTAIN,' he captioned a carousel of photos of himself and Messi.

'It was a dream to be able to have achieved everything we achieved together and to have defended this shirt and our country with you, I'm leaving and we'll miss you always.

In a recent development, 'It was a pleasure to be one of your soldiers for all these years and I will be forever! I love you buddy.'.

Sources indicate that almeno 11 club di Serie A sostengono Giovanni Malagò nella corsa alla presidenza della FIGC, mentre Adriano Galliani raccoglie il sostegno di un altro fronte. Secondo quanto riportato da Calcio e Finanza, La Lega Serie A, che alle precedenti elezioni aveva promosso la candidatura dell’ex numero uno del CONI con uno schieramento compatto, rischia di uscire dalla nuova tornata elettorale divisa al proprio interno.

In a recent development, la scelta del prossimo presidente federale resta aperta tra i due candidati. La divisione nella massima serie riguarda anche gli equilibri interni della Lega in vista delle elezioni dei consiglieri federali.

Industry observers note that secondo quanto riportato dal Corriere dello Sport, alcuni club si sono allontanati dallo schieramento favorevole a Malagò, Atalanta e Inter in testa. Tra le società ancora indecise figurano anche Juventus e Milan.

Alle differenze sulla presidenza della FIGC potrebbe quindi aggiungersi un’ulteriore frattura al momento di eleggere i consiglieri federali. È su entrambi i passaggi che si misura la compattezza mostrata dalla Serie A nella precedente tornata.

Ca c’est le constat dans un stade mythique, un club mythique. Quand on dit ça qu’est-ce qu’on fait ? Est-ce qu’on y va avec le trouillomètre ? Est-ce qu’on y va avec la réalité du football qui dit que tu vas jouer un match de football dans un stade aussi mythique qu’il soit, tu dois jouer un match de football. Voilà le constat réel il est là : tu joues contre une très grosse équipe, et tu devras faire un très gros match, point. Et tu devras jouer comme un match de Coupe de France, comme Domarin a joué contre nous avec toutes ses armes. Comme Paray avec tous ses armes : un maximum d’engagement, le maximum d’énergie et le maximum de concentration en y croyant au maximum.".

OLIVER HOLT: Man United ARE in a relegation battle - anybody who denies it is deluding themselves - and Mauricio Pochettino is already showing signs of cracking under pressure

💡 Key Takeaways

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Published: 07:54 EST, 23 November 2026 | Updated: 10:31 EST, 23 November 2026.

Early on in On the Road, somewhere between Chicago and Denver, Jack Kerouac described the journey his main character was taking and some of the trepidation that came with each newly introduced horizon. ‘I was halfway across America,’ he wrote, ‘at the dividing line between the East of my youth and the West of my future.’.

Late on Sunday afternoon, as winter’s grey light turned to darkness on Merseyside and a bitter wind blew in off the Irish Sea, Manchester United’s new boss, Mauricio Pochettino, freshly arrived from Cincinnati, Ohio, arms folded grimly and tightly across his chest, stood on the touchline at Anfield and realised the full extent of what he had just got himself into.

Recent findings suggest that sure, the United job was too big to turn down. However far the club has fallen, it still has that lure. It still has the name, even if the name is now just one of those building facades on a film set.

There is the name and then there is the nothingness that is concealed beyond the name. There is the mismanaged, mistreated void that United has become.

Industry observers note that and now United need to find out which version of Pochettino they have purchased. Because he is at a dividing line, too. Do they have the Pochettino who blazed a trail across the football landscape with Espanyol, Southampton and Spurs, although he did not win trophies at any of those destinations?

Recent findings suggest that or do they have the Pochettino whose reputation gradually became becalmed at Paris Saint-Germain, Chelsea and the USA national team? They better hope they can restart something in him because this is the biggest and the hardest job Pochettino has ever had and it will take a Herculean effort just to survive.

According to recent reports, do Man United have the Mauricio Pochettino who blazed a trail with Espanyol, Southampton and Spurs? Or do they have the Pochettino whose reputation has fluctuated since?

Industry observers note that that is what this season is about now for these fallen, ruined giants. It is about survival. Nothing more. If Pochettino did not realise it before, he will have realised it during that calamitous 4-0 defeat at Anfield: United are in a relegation battle and anyone who denies that is deluding themselves.

It has been revealed that that is just pride talking. The remnants of what pride remains at United, anyway.

Maybe it hasn’t quite seemed real until now. Just like the prospect of Leicester City winning the Premier League didn’t start to feel real until around Christmas of 2015-16. United going down would be up there with Leicester winning the title in terms of seismic events in the modern English game. It’s time to start taking relegation seriously.

Sources indicate that if you take the blinkers off for just a second, if you banish the muscle memory that tells you United are too successful and too rich to get sucked down into the Championship, then you have to accept that all the ingredients are there for United to get relegated. Take that name away and what’s left?

What’s left is a team that last won a Premier League game on August 30. What’s left is a team that has won one game all season. What’s left is a team that has conceded 34 goals across all competitions, more than any other team in Europe's top five leagues. What’s left is a team that has eight points from its first 11 league games.

Just for context, the Spurs side that spent most of last season haunted by the prospect of relegation, had 18 points at this stage of that campaign. If you still think the rabble currently representing the club are too good to go down, I think you are deluding yourself.

Yes, United played more than 80 minutes of the game against Liverpool with 10 men and, yes, the decision to send off Leny Yoro for his challenge on Alexander Isak was harsh. But the dismissal was also a fig-leaf for Pochettino and United. It was convenient. It was a disguise for what lay beneath.

Recent findings suggest that united also brought it on themselves. Pochettino made one big selection decision before the game when he picked Matthijs de Ligt ahead of Harry Maguire. It was what former bosses in the English game might have described as a ‘big rick’. It was a terrible misjudgment.

Maybe the sending off of Leny Yoro was harsh. But United brought it on themselves.

Sources indicate that matthijs de Ligt (right) was bullied by Alexander Isak at Anfield. Pochettino's decision to play the Dutchman was a terrible misjudgment.

De Ligt’s first action was to watch a long ball from Ronald Araujo sail over his head, gazing at it with a mix of horror and wonder, as you might if you were watching the trajectory of an alien spaceship. Yoro was not quick enough to read De Ligt’s discomfort and so the horror ensued.

It was Pochettino’s first game and it is impossible to judge him yet but it is possible to say this was a bad start.

There were even a couple of worrying signs in his post-match press conference when the bonhomie and the relaxed demeanour that are among his great strengths deserted him.

When he was asked about United being in the relegation zone, he snapped that it was a ‘cheap’ question because he had only just arrived at the club. He said he saw fight in his players, which few others had seen. He blamed everything on the sending off of Yoro, even though it was his selection of De Ligt that had led to it.

Sources indicate that A few alarm bells started to ring. Only faintly and only in the distance but they were ringing nonetheless. Pochettino has had major jobs before but he has never had a job as big as Manchester United where the scrutiny and the expectation and the judgment is relentless and unforgiving.

Pochettino has dealt with Daniel Levy at Spurs, which may not have been an easy relationship, but he has never dealt with a clown-show like the one that Jim Ratcliffe has put in place at Old Trafford.

It has been revealed that united is rotten. Everyone can see that. Off the pitch, the club is at war with its own fans. The club gives every impression of trying to move on its most loyal supporters so that it can replace them with tourists and day-trippers who will spend more on tickets and in the club superstore and at the food stands.

‘The way you treat us is a disgrace,’ that banner in the Stretford End stated a few weeks ago, and that is how the fans feel. They are more loyal than United deserve but their patience with their owners ran out a long time ago. Pochettino has a disaffected fanbase to deal with as well.

United is rotten on the pitch and it is rotten off the pitch. It feels as if the club is being slowly poisoned in plain sight. It feels as if it is getting weaker and weaker and weaker. And when Brentford arrive at Old Trafford next week, they will smell blood. Every club that comes to Old Trafford now smells blood.

Harry Maguire looks dejected at full-time on Sunday. United is rotten on the pitch and it is rotten off the pitch. It feels as if the club is being slowly poisoned in plain sight.

It has been revealed that still think they’re too good to go down? Who are they better than in this league? Hull City? United don’t have the spirit of Hull City. They don’t have the togetherness. They don’t have the pride.

Hull got battered by Brighton on Sunday afternoon and still won 2-0. United could never have done that. United have already lost to Hull and Brighton this season, too.

Sources indicate that so, yes, United are in a relegation fight. They’re one off the bottom of the league in the last week of November. Of course, they’re in a relegation fight. It’s on their new boss to get them out of it.

If Pochettino is on the wrong side of the dividing line of his career, if the best part of his journey is behind him, United are in major, big trouble.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Il presidente della Lazio punta a tornare nell’incarico; per i tre posti si presentano anche gli uscenti e Sticchi Damiani.

La Serie A eleggerà tre consiglieri federali il 14 dicembre, ma i candidati sono cinque. Ai tre uscenti Stefano Campoccia, Giorgio Chiellini e Giuseppe Marotta si sono aggiunti Saverio Sticchi Damiani e il presidente della Lazio Claudio Lotito. Tra le ipotesi in vista del voto c’è anche quella di preferenze disgiunte tra la presidenza FIGC e il Consiglio federale.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Sources indicate that nel breve mandato di Malagò, i posti spettanti alla massima serie erano occupati da Campoccia, dell’Udinese, Chiellini, della Juventus, e Marotta, dell’Inter. Tutti e tre si sono ricandidati. Con loro correranno il presidente del Lecce Sticchi Damiani e Lotito, che punta a tornare nell’incarico già ricoperto.

Sources indicate that come riferisce il Corriere dello Sport, il quadro delle candidature si inserisce in una Serie A attraversata da divisioni. Alcuni club sono usciti dal fronte Malagò, con Atalanta e Inter in testa. Tra gli indecisi figurano anche Juventus e Milan; in vista delle elezioni dei consiglieri federali, le fratture interne potrebbero allargarsi.

Ogni società di Serie A può indicare un candidato al Consiglio federale. Nelle precedenti elezioni Chiellini aveva ottenuto sette voti e Marotta sei, in una situazione descritta come praticamente opposta a quella attuale.

Il fronte favorevole a Galliani, guidato dal presidente interista Marotta, potrebbe risentire della propria posizione di minoranza. I club che sostengono Malagò sono almeno 11: un sostegno necessario alla sua candidatura, per la quale serve l’appoggio di almeno una componente.

It has been revealed that in questo scenario, alcune società potrebbero scegliere il voto disgiunto: sostenere un candidato alla presidenza FIGC e, per il Consiglio federale, esprimere una preferenza per un nome non apertamente schierato con lui. L’esempio indicato è un voto per Malagò alla presidenza e per Marotta, primo sostenitore di Galliani, come consigliere. Una soluzione che richiederebbe un lavoro diplomatico.

Latest Update: La Calade des gens heureux

⏱️ ~4 mins left to finish

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Heureux comme tous les membres du FC Villefranche Beaujolais d'affronter les Verts dans le Chaudron après-demain soir, le président caladois Philippe Terrier s'est confié ce jeudi à BFM.
  • "A 48 heures de la rencontre, on sent que ça commence à monter.
  • J'ai accepté d'être président en 2010, le jour où on a joué contre Saint-Étienne.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Heureux comme tous les membres du FC Villefranche Beaujolais d'affronter les Verts dans le Chaudron après-demain soir, le président caladois Philippe Terrier s'est confié ce jeudi à BFM. Extraits.

"A 48 heures de la rencontre, on sent que ça commence à monter. Au club, les gens en parlent de plus en plus. Il y a l'effervescence qui est en train de venir et il y a beaucoup de monde qui va se déplacer. C'est un véritable moment de bonheur qu'on est en train de vivre. C'est le sujet de conversation à Villefranche, en Calade, cette semaine. Il y a eu le marathon qui était un véritable succès. Derrière, on enclenche avec ce match qui restera historique. Il y aura entre 2 000 et 3 000 Caladois qui vont faire le déplacement. On attend 20 000 personnes dans le stade. Il va falloir faire du bruit pour se faire entendre.

J'ai accepté d'être président en 2010, le jour où on a joué contre Saint-Étienne. On avait fait match nul à la fin du temps réglementaire. Puis, après les prolongations, on avait perdu aux tirs au but. Mais le moment était tellement merveilleux que quand l'ancien président s'est tourné vers moi et m'a demandé si j'acceptais le poste... Avec l'euphorie, j’ai dit oui. C'est le lendemain que j'ai compris que j'avais fait une bêtise, mais sur le moment, je pensais avoir bien fait. Une bêtise qui dure quand même, parce que ça fait 16 ans que je suis resté.

Aujourd'hui, c'est un bonheur. 16 ans après, on retrouve Saint-Étienne sur notre parcours.C'est beau quand même. C'est assez émouvant. Mais cette fois, ce sera à Geoffroy-Guichard, dans le Chaudron. L’ASSE, c'est une véritable équipe de Ligue 1. C'est une équipe qui pourrait rivaliser avec beaucoup d'équipes du niveau supérieur. Sur un match de Coupe de France, on sait que tout est possible. On part à 50-50 et on verra bien.

On a encaissé 4 buts lors d enotre match contre Bastia. Il faudra que notre défense soit beaucoup plus solide et surtout beaucoup plus concentrée. Parce qu'il y a eu beaucoup d'erreurs sur les quatre buts qu'on a pris. Il y a eu beaucoup d'erreurs d'attention. Je pense que les joueurs seront beaucoup plus concentrés à Saint-Etienne. Mais les adversaires seront d'une autre taille, c'est ça le problème !

Le message que j’ai passé tout au long de la semaine aux joueurs, c’est avant tout, de se faire plaisir et de se dire que c'est possible. Que sur un match, ils peuvent être au niveau.Un exploit, c'est tellement beau à vivre qu'il faut qu’ils vivent ce moment avec intensité. On verra bien ce qui se passera. Les joueurs vont jouer à 110 ou 120 % de leurs moyens. Parfois, il y a une équipe en face qui ne peut jouer qu'à 90 % de ses moyens. La motivation n'est pas la même. C'est aussi une façon pour les joueurs de montrer qu'on ne s'est pas trompés quand on les a recrutés et qu'ils sont bien meilleurs que ce qu'ils ont proposé jusqu'à présent. On sait qu'ils seront présents.

Industry observers note that L'état d'esprit du groupe, c’est vraiment le travail, le travail, le travail ! Il faut qu'on corrige tout ce qu'on a mal fait. Il faut qu'on soit bon samedi. Le coach se charge de leur mettre un peu la pression. Je sais que tout le Rhône va être derrière le FCVB samedi, ça va au-delà de la Calade. On a eu la chance de jouer au Groupama Stadium en 2019 contre le PSG. C'était quelque chose d'incroyable. L'autre stade dans lequel j'espérais faire un match un jour, c'était Geoffroy Guichard. Donc, avant tout, c'est une fête.

La Coupe de France, c'est un objectif. Je l'ai dit aux joueurs, je l'ai dit au groupe. Il faut aller le plus loin possible parce qu'il y a encore le souvenir de l'an dernier, de cette sortie de route très tôt face à un club de R3. On a 650 partenaires, le meilleur moyen de les récompenser, c'est de faire quelque chose de phénoménal en Coupe de France. On pioche en championnat. Si on offre à nos partenaires une victoire contre Saint-Etienne, ce serait juste l'euphorie dans la ville.

Le Caladois est un peu chauvin. Si on le fait, ce serait le top. On peut le faire ! C'est déjà un très beau cadeau de jouer contre Saint-Etienne. Si on va plus loin, c'est l’apothéose ! Je n'ai pas vraiment préparé ce que je vais dire aux joueurs samedi avant la rencontre, mais je vais avant tout leur demander de tout donner, et que quel que soit le résultat, qu'on soit fier d'eux et qu'on puisse dire qu'ils ont donné tout ce qu'ils avaient dans le ventre pour présenter un beau spectacle.".

#222168. Breaking: Sheepish Man United stars roll into Carrington after 4-0 trouncing at Liverpool as Mauricio Pochettino and Co launch FA appeal against Leny Yoro's 'painful' red card

📅 23 Nov 2026 • ⏱️ 6m • 📚 Deep Dive (1243 w)
📖 Baca
General 📈 Bullish 🌐 Dailymail ↗ Open Full Page

Breaking: Sheepish Man United stars roll into Carrington after 4-0 trouncing at Liverpool as Mauricio Pochettino and Co launch FA appeal against Leny Yoro's 'painful' red card

📅 23 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 6 min read (1243 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Dailymail

⏱️ ~6 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • By OLLIE LEWIS, SPORTS DIGITAL EDITOR and CHRIS WHEELER, NORTHERN SPORTS WRITER.
  • Published: 05:58 EST, 23 November 2026 | Updated: 10:41 EST, 23 November 2026.
  • Mauricio Pochettino hauled his beleaguered Man United stars back into Carrington early on Monday morning after the new manager's chastening Anfield bow on Sunday.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By OLLIE LEWIS, SPORTS DIGITAL EDITOR and CHRIS WHEELER, NORTHERN SPORTS WRITER.

Published: 05:58 EST, 23 November 2026 | Updated: 10:41 EST, 23 November 2026.

Mauricio Pochettino hauled his beleaguered Man United stars back into Carrington early on Monday morning after the new manager's chastening Anfield bow on Sunday.

Pochettino, who replaced Michael Carrick last week, was served a sobering reality check at the hands of United's fierce rivals Liverpool, with the Red Devils on the receiving end of a 4-0 trouncing on Merseyside.

The Argentine bemoaned the impact of what he described as a harsh red card against defender Leny Yoro in the opening eight minutes of the contest, but admitted he has plenty to do to turn things around - with United stuck in 19th in the Premier League table.

And Pochettino had his players check in for training early on Monday morning, with a downcast Bruno Fernandes and his team-mates spotted arriving at around 8.30am - roughly an hour earlier than under Carrick.

Under Carrick's stewardship, players were given the day after a game off, and it remains to be seen whether Pochettino will do away with that approach in favour of a recovery day at the club's training ground - a similar approach to that taken by former United boss Ruben Amorim.

Man United stars were ordered back into training on Monday after their trouncing at Anfield.

Matthijs de Ligt cut a contemplative figure as he drove through the gates at Carrington.

Director of football Jason Wilcox continues to have questions to answer after Man United were unable to elevate themselves out of the relegation zone.

News also came on Monday that Man United are appealing to the FA over Yoro’s controversial red card.

Yoro was sent off in the eighth minute for a challenge on Alexander Isak on the edge of the penalty box. The Frenchman was dismissed by referee Sam Barrott, and Dominik Szoboszlai scored Liverpool’s first goal from the free kick as 10-man United were thrashed 4-0.

However, United insist that Yoro did not deny Isak a clear goalscoring opportunity because goalkeeper Senne Lammens would have reached the ball first.

The club have notified the FA of their intention to appeal in the hope of having Yoro’s one-match ban overturned so he can play against Brentford at Old Trafford on Saturday.

In September, Pro Ref boss Howard Webb apologised to United when Erling Haaland’s winning goal for Manchester City in the Old Trafford derby was allowed to stand after VAR incorrectly ruled that teammate Enzo Fernandez was not interfering with play as he tried to head the ball in an offside position.

Last season, Webb acknowledged that the match officials got it wrong when they decided not to send off Brentford captain Nathan Collins for hauling back Bryan Mbeumo inside the box as United lost 3-1 at the Gtech Community Stadium.

Fresh United head coach Pochettino blamed Yoro’s red card for the heavy defeat in his first game in charge, and was unhappy that Barrott took no action over a similar incident involving Jeremy Jacquet and Mbeumo in the Liverpool penalty area moments earlier.

'So painful, so disappointed,' said the Argentine. 'It's not OK to start a game in the Premier League with this situation. The game changed completely after eight minutes. Now we can explain everything, but the damage is done – it's so painful.

'It's clear that after eight minutes the blueprint was in the bin. Do you think that is easy? Even the best team in the world playing in this situation concedes four goals or maybe more.

'We are not going to lose more than one game how we lost today. I take the responsibility, and we keep pushing.

'We feel pain for this defeat, but we need to keep our heads up and translate that anger into energy to start to work from tomorrow for the next game.

Industry observers note that 'We are in a situation that this is very complicated. It's difficult, yes, but I think we fight, we made the effort, and I know how they feel now in the dressing-room.

'The players are feeling the pain of the result. I told them to be calm: it was an unfair situation that happened. We need to accept that reality. We need to try to increase our focus, concentration and make better decisions on the field.

'We also need to be critical on ourselves but some situations happened in the game that we are not happy.'.

But more critical were former Red Devils Roy Keane and Gary Neville, both of whom were pushed to extremes assessing the match after the final whistle.

Lisandro Martinez was among the Man United defenders that Gary Neville did not feel were up to the task at Anfield.

But incoming manager Pochettino was keen to place the majority of blame on the harsh red card doled out to Leny Yoro.

Neville was driven to slapping his face in the Sky Sports studio to demonstrate Man United's defenders' lack of hunger and poise.

'I never see any of them on their toes, alert, looking like they've got something fixed in here', he mentioned before pointing to his head.

'I never see any of them look like that,' he added. 'They look like that -'.

Neville then stared into the middle distance for a few moments to share the blankness he sees on the faces of the back line, before spitting: 'Wake up!'.

The Overlap broadcaster slapped himself a number of times while repeating 'wake up!' and adding: 'You play for Man United'.

Keane was pushed to the brink of swearing in his snap description of the team's performance, adding that he thought Neville's verdict - that the 4-0 scoreline might have been worse under the circumstances - took players off the hook.

In a recent development, 'If I hear that one more time from the lads in the commentary that 4-0 is not too bad when you're down to 10 men - has a team ever got a result with 10 men before?' Keane said immediately after the final whistle. 'It can be done.

'I thought United were desperate. I thought they were so bad and everyone and Nev, who played for Man United saying 4-0 ain't bad.'.

Industry observers note that '(The red card) doesn't help but you're telling me they couldn't have done better? They lost 4-0 with 10 men, that's not too bad? Has a team ever got a result with 10 men? It can be done. At least show a bit more fight, a bit more quality - I can't believe what I'm hearing from people.

According to recent reports, 'You played for the club, saying 4-0 isn't too bad. Wow. Fans are applauding. Applauding what? Performing rubbish. Liverpool were excellent, but how easy did United make it for them? I can't believe what I'm watching sometimes.

Recent findings suggest that 'This team two years ago finished 15th. The last year or two, we're talking. We're blaming the board, blaming ownership, blaming managers.

According to recent reports, 'When do the players take responsibility for some decision-making? Liverpool probably should have scored eight, probably eight or nine, unbelievable chances they had. And everyone's coming off the pitch saying 4 is not too bad? I feel like swearing.'.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Dopo dieci anni al Manchester City, il tecnico scelse di fermarsi; ora considera un incarico da commissario tecnico.

Pep Guardiola disse no alla panchina dell'Italia la scorsa estate. L'allenatore spagnolo, 55 anni, lo ha raccontato a Romário TV, il programma YouTube condotto dall'ex fuoriclasse brasiliano. Per la prima volta ha parlato pubblicamente dei contatti con la Federcalcio e delle ragioni per cui non è arrivato alla Nazionale azzurra.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

A presentargli una proposta ufficiale furono Paolo Maldini e Leonardo, ex bandiere del Milan. Guardiola ha confermato di aver parlato con loro: «Ne parlo per la prima volta, ma sì, ho parlato con loro. Ero quasi in imbarazzo nel dire di no all'Italia».

La possibilità di guidare gli azzurri lo attirava molto. Il tecnico ha spiegato quanto avrebbe significato per lui accettare l'incarico: «Sarebbe stato uno dei più grandi onori della mia carriera allenare la nazionale italiana».

Industry observers note that alla base del rifiuto c'era la stanchezza. Guardiola arrivava da dieci anni al Manchester City, durante i quali aveva conquistato sei campionati e una Champions League. Alle spalle aveva inoltre 18 anni complessivi in panchina, scanditi da partite ogni tre giorni.

Recent findings suggest that sentiva così il bisogno di prendersi una pausa. Nel raccontare quella decisione, ha detto: «Mi sono reso conto che dovevo smettere. Avevo bisogno di un po' di tempo per me stesso».

Ian Holloway SACKED by Swindon two days after trying to confront angry fans in feisty full-time scenes at Newport - with Premier League cult hero claiming club's training ground is haunted

📅 23 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 3 min read (679 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Dailymail

⏱️ ~3 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Published: 05:52 EST, 23 November 2026 | Updated: 10:57 EST, 23 November 2026.
  • Ian Holloway has been sacked by Swindon just two days after attempting to confront angry fans following defeat to Newport on Saturday.
  • The journeyman manager had himself called the 2-0 loss on the road 'unforgivable' after he was taunted by home supporters chanting that he would be 'sacked in the morning' after the result.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By TAMARA PRENN, SENIOR SPORTS REPORTER.

Published: 05:52 EST, 23 November 2026 | Updated: 10:57 EST, 23 November 2026.

Ian Holloway has been sacked by Swindon just two days after attempting to confront angry fans following defeat to Newport on Saturday.

The journeyman manager had himself called the 2-0 loss on the road 'unforgivable' after he was taunted by home supporters chanting that he would be 'sacked in the morning' after the result.

Holloway had intended to go down the tunnel after the final whistle, and passed the away stand on his route out, taking off his cap as he held up his hands in resignation.

But as boos rained down on him, the 63-year-old could not resist the urge to engage, looking to answer back to the fans before he was restrained by security.

Last month, Holloway described himself as a 'dead man walking' with the Robins mired 17th in League Two, but Monday morning saw him despatched after two seasons in charge.

'Since joining the club towards the end of 2024, Ian has played an vital role in stabilising our on-field position and helping the club make progress season upon season,' the Swindon statement announcing his departure read.

Saturdays eh.#STFC pic.twitter.com/1GL3blApwW.

Ian Holloway was caught up in a clash with fans after Swindon's defeat to Newport County - shortly before he was sacked (Source: X/Loathed Stranger).

The journeyman manager oversaw two seasons at the club, saving them from relegation in 2024-25.

'However, following careful consideration of recent results and performances, the club believes that now is the right time to take a different direction.

'This has not been an easy decision, but the board firmly believes that it is notable to make difficult decisions when necessary, always with the best interests of Swindon Town at heart.'.

Holloway cut a disillusioned figure at Rodney Parade as he gave a heartfelt assessment of his side's performance after defeat to the Exiles.

Sources indicate that 'It's devastating,' noted Holloway. 'I'm bitterly disappointed. Did I expect my team to do that? Not in a million years.

Sources indicate that 'We're getting regular mistakes from almost everyone in that backline and in that midfield. We knew what type of game it was going to be. There's no excuses. I've just stated to them "what on Earth do you think you're doing?" To start that way? It was so passive it was unforgivable.

'It's very painful at the minute. It'll come back at the manager in the end if I listen to all these people (from the stands).

'This is football. I've been in it a long time. This is my life.'.

Holloway also questioned the desire of his players, continuing: 'Bitterly disappointed in all of them and disappointed for the fans. I get it, that didn't look like our team.

According to recent reports, 'They scored two ugly goals. All our chances that we had, normally we take them.

In a recent development, 'Where's the fight? It's a local derby. I'm sorry, they've done their bits better than us.'.

Holloway has endured an uneven stint at Swindon since 2024, saving the club from relegation in his first season but failing to challenge for the promotion places as time wore on.

Memorably, the former Crystal Palace and Queen's Park Rangers manager claimed that the training ground was haunted shortly after his arrival in Wiltshire.

Holloway had first suggested that there had been 'some strange things happening' after the club captain Ollie Clarke had ruptured his ankle in training, before enlisting his wife Kim to free spirits potentially trapped in the South West.

'I'm absolutely devastated so I'm going to try and cleanse the training ground area because people are telling me it's haunted,' Holloway said on BBC Radio Wiltshire in November 2024.

'There's a graveyard somewhere near. Honestly, I'm not joking.

'I think our training ground is very close to an ancient burial site so I'm going to get my wife to come up and say sorry to all these people and hopefully we'll have a bit more luck.'.

💡 Key Takeaways

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Are you the most knowledgeable football fan around? Do you want to be involved with EA SPORTS FIFA? Well, you’re in luck as the FIFA Talent Scout team is looking for people like you.

The FIFA Talent Scout community has over 6000 active members and is always looking for individuals to help improve their football database.

This is a great opportunity to put your knowledge of your club to good use, helping to ensure that the EA SPORTS football database continues to contain the most up to date and accurate team and player data for the many leagues featured in FIFA 17.

The first step into our community is as a football analyst, who can examine team and player data and offer feedback suggesting possible changes. You can contribute towards improving player appearance, player attributes, team formations and team tactics. There is no minimum or maximum expectation in terms of your contribution to the database. We are able to offer some financial compensation to editors, but in return we do require that you are a very active contributor who works to our deadlines and in line with our guidelines.

  • Sources indicate that "Cette semaine j'ai axé nos séances sur le dépassement de soi.
  • According to recent reports, si tu ne joues pas pleinement ce match, tu n'en joueras aucun.

Le Patriote du Beaujolais rapporte les propos tenus par l'entraîneur caladois Hakim Malek, attendu demain soir à Geoffroy.

Sources indicate that "Cette semaine j'ai axé nos séances sur le dépassement de soi. Après, est-ce que ça se verra en match ? C'est toujours pareil. Ce que tu bosses à l'entraînement, quand arrive le match, sous pression, avec de l'enjeu, il faut voir si tu es en capacité de le reproduire sur ces principes travaillés en semaine. Je ne suis pas sûr. Saint-Etienne, c'est une équipe de Ligue 1 qui joue en Ligue 2. Tu dois y aller en étant décomplexé. Je ne fais pas de langue de bois. Ce match, tu peux le jouer 50 fois, tu le perdras 49 fois ! La seule chose à prendre en compte, c'est de savoir si nous serons dans la seule fois où nous pouvons gagner ce match.

According to recent reports, si tu ne joues pas pleinement ce match, tu n'en joueras aucun. Dans la logique, tu n'as rien à perdre parce que tout est perdu depuis le début ! Tu as vraiment tout à gagner. Le tour d'avant, quand Saint-Etienne a joué contre Rumilly, il leur manquait 12 internationaux. Là, ce sera tout autre-chose. C'est une machine de guerre ! C'est équilibré, ça court vite, ça possède de la mobilité, ça saute haut, ça presse, ça met de l'intensité. C'est une équipe de Ligue 1. Dans ma tête, j'y vais pour gagner, c'est normal. Mais dans l'absolu si tu perds, ce ne sera pas un exploit pour eux.".

Sources indicate that to finish up this initial trip around the net, we alert you to FourFourTwo's list of the 59 best Under-21 footballers from around the world. The section we highlight has a mini profile of Porto striker André Silva, who will be hoping to net his first senior international goal tonight for the Seleção against Andorra. In case you're wondering, the British magazine rank him at number 23.

#222147. Industry News: Top five football betting tips and tricks

📅 31 Aug 2018 • ⏱️ 4m • 📚 Deep Dive (776 w)
📖 Baca
General ⚖️ Neutral 🌐 Portugoal ↗ Open Full Page

Industry News: Top five football betting tips and tricks

📅 31 Aug 2018 | ⏱️ 4 min read (776 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Portugoal

⏱️ ~4 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Football is the world’s most famous sport, and it is the sport of choice of a great many sports punters as well.
  • According to recent reports, getting started on football betting is far from easy, though.
  • But experience is not the only thing that can help you become a better football punter.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Football is the world’s most famous sport, and it is the sport of choice of a great many sports punters as well. Especially popular in Europe, betting on football can be an incredibly profitable enterprise, so long as you know how to do it.

According to recent reports, getting started on football betting is far from easy, though. This form of gambling requires dedication, investment, and persistence. As you gain experience, your intuition will improve and you will be able to make more correct predictions.

But experience is not the only thing that can help you become a better football punter. In fact, you can substantially improve your betting strategy by simply following some basic football betting tips.

Recent findings suggest that you might find shopping around boring and unhelpful, but you just have to do it when you search sites for football betting. As you know, the higher the odds, the bigger the payout. What you may have missed, however, is that odds are different at each bookmaker. Having mentioned that, shopping around for the best odds is sensible, as it rewards you with bigger payouts.

In this line of thought, sticking to one bookmaker is virtually pointless. Even if the bookie of your choosing offers the best odds for a number of matches, it is highly unlikely that their odds will remain the best for long.

An obvious one, we know. And yet, you will be surprised by the number of football bettors who wager on football, but do not follow the sport. So, why is it key to follow the action closely?

Sources indicate that first of all, by watching football matches, you can take part in the most exciting football betting market – the live betting market. What is more important, however, is that following the action provides an invaluable insight into teams and players’ style, condition, and determination – important factors  to consider when placing a bet.

As you watch more and more games, you will improve your analytic abilities. In time, you will be able to make more accurate predictions about the outcome of different matches, which, of course,  will result in placing more winning bets.

As you know, odds are based on the probability of occurrence of a certain outcome; the higher the odds, the more unlikely it is for that outcome to actually occur. But what happens when the odds offered by the bookmaker represent a probability that is lower than the actual probability of an outcome occurring? In such a situation, you can place what is called a value bet.

If you want to become a professional football punter, you should always search for value when betting, as it leads to huge profits.

Industry observers note that favoured by beginners in particular, accumulators are a type of football wager which allows you to bet on as many fixtures as you like. Most commonly, you will be asked to choose a match winner, but as the market is diverse, you may be offered a number of other betting options. What makes accumulators an appealing betting market is the huge potential payout – here, you can stake as little as £1 and have the potential to win more than £500,000, depending on the bookmaker and the number of selected fixtures.

Industry observers note that if you find accumulators’ payouts too good to be true, you are right. As a matter of fact, there is a reason for the odds to be set so high – actually winning an accumulator bet, especially one which involves a wide selection of matches, is nearly impossible. You see, all you need for your whole wager to lose is one wrong prediction. For example, if you bet on 10 matches and just one of them goes wrong, your entire accumulator is lost.

To make money by betting on football, avoid betting on accumulators – the risk is simply not worth it.

Finally, if you want to be a successful football punter, learn how not to mix emotions with betting. This is easier noted than done, though.

Whenever your favourite team plays, you want them to win, regardless of how (im)possible that may be. If you do not learn how to leave emotions out of betting, however, you are highly likely to put money on your favourite team even if they have no chance of winning the match. Conversely, should you base your bets on hard facts and not on emotions, you increase your chances to win.

Our advice – avoid betting on fixtures that involve one of your favourite teams, that is the easiest way to keep emotions at bay.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

La campagna coinvolge sei calciatori e calciatrici delle Nazionali e rinnova l’invito a comporre il 1522.

Sources indicate that la FIGC rinnova il suo impegno contro la violenza sulle donne con una campagna di sensibilizzazione affidata a sei calciatori e calciatrici e ribadisce l’invito alle vittime di violenza o stalking a chiamare il 1522. Secondo quanto riportato da Figc, L’iniziativa è legata alla Giornata internazionale per l’eliminazione della violenza sulle donne. Lo riferisce la FIGC.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Gianluigi Donnarumma, Cristiana Girelli, Laura Giuliani, Pio Esposito, Riccardo Calafiori e Annamaria Serturini sono i protagonisti della comunicazione della Federazione. La campagna affronta la violenza di genere in tutte le sue forme: non soltanto gli episodi di cronaca, ancora troppo frequenti, ma anche la dimensione culturale e sociale del fenomeno, legata agli stereotipi e al mancato riconoscimento della libertà e dell’autonomia delle donne.

Il messaggio distingue la violenza da ciò che può essere presentato come una lite, il controllo dalla gelosia e il possesso dalla protezione: «È una lite? No, è violenza. È gelosia? No, è controllo. È protezione? No, è possesso». A queste domande la campagna affianca una risposta: il numero 1522.

It has been revealed that il 1522 è un servizio gratuito di pubblica utilità istituito nel 2006 dal Dipartimento per le Pari Opportunità. Il suo obiettivo è favorire l’emersione e il contrasto della violenza contro le donne, sia all’interno sia all’esterno della famiglia, attraverso un’ampia azione di sistema.

In occasione della Giornata internazionale, la FIGC torna quindi a invitare le vittime di ogni forma di violenza o stalking a comporre il numero.

#222142. Industry News: Bayern Munich slammed as 'despicable' and accused of 'co-ordinated' plot to undermine Jamal Musiala after club chief questioned star's contract due to his health complications - with Jude Bellingham, Michael Olise and Rio Ferdinand backing the youngster

Industry News: Bayern Munich slammed as 'despicable' and accused of 'co-ordinated' plot to undermine Jamal Musiala after club chief questioned star's contract due to his health complications - with Jude Bellingham, Michael Olise and Rio Ferdinand backing the youngster

📅 23 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 7 min read (1370 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Dailymail

⏱️ ~7 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Published: 10:38 EST, 23 November 2026 | Updated: 11:29 EST, 23 November 2026.
  • Bayern Munich have come under criticism from FIFA's players' union and leading figures in the game amid accusations that the club is attempting to slash Jamal Musiala's wages following his diagnosis with a 'neurological dysfunction'.
  • The Germany international was diagnosed over the summer with absence seizures, a form of epilepsy which causes 'brief but easily treatable seizures'.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By TAMARA PRENN, SENIOR SPORTS REPORTER.

Published: 10:38 EST, 23 November 2026 | Updated: 11:29 EST, 23 November 2026.

Bayern Munich have come under criticism from FIFA's players' union and leading figures in the game amid accusations that the club is attempting to slash Jamal Musiala's wages following his diagnosis with a 'neurological dysfunction'.

The Germany international was diagnosed over the summer with absence seizures, a form of epilepsy which causes 'brief but easily treatable seizures'.

Musiala shocked the sporting world when he collapsed in two matches earlier this season, with Bayern manager Vincent Kompany explaining that the player had suffered from a reaction to a change in his medication.

Comments from members of Bayern's hierarchy have sparked controversy in Germany and abroad, with senior figures appearing to question the length of the player's contract – which runs until 2030 – should Musiala not recover his form.

Honorary president Uli Hoeness was the first to speak out on the potential drop-off in form Musiala might suffer with long-term absences, claiming earlier this month that he 'may never regain the performance level he once had'.

'We are facing a dilemma in this case, as he is suffering from an illness that cannot simply be cured, but it can be controlled to a certain extent with the use of medication,' Hoeness told German outlet BR24.

Fifpro and international footballers have come out in support of Musiala over concerns that Bayern Munich might reduce his salary.

Both Uli Hoeness and Karl-Heinz Rummenigge have made comments suggesting consequences should Musiala not return to his level.

Jan-Christian Dreesen also suggested that the club would need to 'assess' the situation if his performances do not return to their high heights.

Chief executive Jan-Christian Dreesen then backed up Hoeness's comments and implied that Musiala's contract may need to be 'assessed'.

'We're monitoring his level of play. He'll certainly need time to improve further – like any injured player,' Dreesen noted in discussion with AZ. 'And then we need to calmly assess the situation and, if necessary, sit down with his family and management.

'Either we'll all be happy together and he'll be the same Jamal he always was – or, if he's a different Jamal along the way, we'll have to discuss it.'.

According to recent reports, 'If we're not consistently at a level that also aligns with the economic realities, then we'll have to talk to each other. Nevertheless, we have a valid contract, and that's the end of it.'.

In a recent development, the 23-year-old is one of Bayern's highest-earners, having signed a deal with the club to extend his time in Bavaria in February 2025. The deal is thought to be worth £18.4million per year.

Adding fuel to the fire days later was former CEO Karl-Heinz Rummenigge, who told Sky Sports/RTL that he thought it was almost reasonable to discuss a renegotiation should Musiala not return to the level at which he once played.

'That is certainly possible and cannot be ruled out,' he remarked. 'Unfortunately, what we know suggests that it will be difficult to reach the level that he has so often shown here in this stadium.'.

'We need to talk to the family, the player, and above all, the agency. Because then these sums are – sorry, with all due respect – no longer feasible.

Industry observers note that 'I can't imagine Jamal leaving the club or another club buying him under these circumstances. That's a problem. I think we handled this very sensitively with the player, and we're all interested in him coming back - ideally in top form. But what happens if that's not the case? Then we'll still have to think about the finances. And that's a task that the board and the supervisory board unfortunately have to make.'.

Rummenigge added that he did not think it was 'problematic' for these discussions to be happening publicly, due to the club's interest in 'him coming back and playing well'.

But the player union Fifpro were forthright in their disagreement with his statements,  releasing a statement claiming that all parties right now sharing their views on Musiala's contract 'should know better'.

'Bayern's honorary president, chief executive and former chief executive have all publicly questioned Musiala's contract in quick succession,' the statement read.

In a recent development, 'In Fifpro's view, this is a co-ordinated strategy to put pressure on Musiala and his representatives ahead of any negotiations. A club of Bayern's standing should know better.'.

When this statement was shared to social media via journalist Fabrizio Romano, global talents including Jude Bellingham and Musiala's team-mate Michael Olise were among those to like the post.

Musiala collapsed on the pitch at two consecutive games in August (pictured being helped by team-mates against RB Leipzig).

The 23-year-old has been diagnosed with absence seizures and is managing his medication.

Vincent Kompany has been supportive of his player's struggles, and took him off the bench with some success last weekend.

Rio Ferdinand elaborated on those comments in a more detailed post on social media, adding that he believed the club are 'better than this'.

In a recent development, 'If they want to negotiate more reasonable terms for the club going forward due to the health issues Jamal has, then surely speak to him and his team rather than to the media,' Ferdinand wrote on X. 'This situation must be hard enough to deal with for Jamal without the media and club officials talking about it publicly.

Recent findings suggest that 'Bayern Munich are one of the clubs who from afar have always carried themselves with a class and standard that most have admired. Sadly, this just doesn't feel like Bayern Munich in this situation.'.

Criticisms were even more fiery in Germany, with the vice president of Germany's player union Michael Franz accusing the club of harassment.

Recent findings suggest that 'What the Bayern Munich officials are doing, and I don't mean Kompany and (Max) Eberl (director of sport), who have behaved impeccably, seems despicable to me,' Franz shared in an interview with Sport1. 'There is even something about it that resembles harassment.'.

It has been revealed that 'A footballer's level of performance can be discussed publicly, but it is not right to talk about his illness and the salary he receives in such circumstances. We must not forget that Jamal Musiala has done everything in his power to come back.'.

'Money has become more important than the person, and that is unacceptable.'.

Former Bayern captain Stefan Effenberg stressed how important 'support and protection' from the club towards their players is, particularly for those in greater need like Musiala.

'We are talking about someone who is suffering from an illness. What I would have expected is for the club's senior officials to apologise,' Effenberg said, adding that he thought that the communications from the club had been 'disastrous'.

Musiala collapsed twice within four days in mid-August, first during Bayern's match against Leipzig – shortly after scoring – and then against Heidenheim.

He then returned to the pitch in September, netting against Bodo/Glimt in Champions League action and Union Berlin shortly before the first international break.

After suffering a hamstring injury, Musiala then spent time away from the side before his return at the end of last week – a match which also saw Harry Kane suffer an ankle injury which will keep him out for over three months.

Fifpro's statement went on to add that Bayern must be careful with their player's mental wellbeing as well as his physical problems.

Recent findings suggest that 'Bayern has a duty of care to Musiala,' the statement continued. 'Across professional football, uncertainty about a player's future can take a toll on their mental health, particularly when they are recovering from injury.

'Making Musiala's health and future a matter of public debate adds to that pressure. Any concerns about his contract should be raised privately with him and his representatives.

It has been revealed that 'Contracts are there to be respected. An injury or a dip in form gives a club no grounds to reopen terms it agreed to, just as a run of outstanding performances gives a player no automatic right to a pay rise.'.

Opinion: The morality of football

📅 08 Jun 2023 | ⏱️ 6 min read (1295 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Portugoal

⏱️ ~6 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Yesterday evening, Selecao correspondent Nathan Motz accepted a unique opportunity to appear as a guest on the Moral Maze – a BBC radio broadcast dealing with matters of moral and ethical significance.
  • In a recent development, is football a moral force for good?
  • In a recent development, nathan’s segment was concerned with whether football has transcendent moral value, and what that is exactly.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Yesterday evening, Selecao correspondent Nathan Motz accepted a unique opportunity to appear as a guest on the Moral Maze – a BBC radio broadcast dealing with matters of moral and ethical significance.

In a recent development, is football a moral force for good? That was the question of the day, and each of the four guests were asked to discuss various aspects of the debate from financial fairplay to club takeovers by foreign entities to racism.

In a recent development, nathan’s segment was concerned with whether football has transcendent moral value, and what that is exactly. Is there a greater significance to the game we are watching, or is it merely 22 humans kicking a leather ball into a net?

Join Nathan as he elaborates on the most significant takeaways of what was a fascinating discussion on the sport and morality in general.

In a recent development, football, for some, may be the most poignant reminder of the moral universe in which we live. While debate has raged for centuries regarding the precise origin of moral absolutes and how humans ought to live, it is simply unavoidable to say humanity is often troubled by events surrounding the game we all love so dearly.

Industry observers note that in not so distant history, every normal act of human life would have been assigned some degree of moral significance. Every action had inherently moral indicators - for good or for evil. Today, postmodern views of morality dominate. These describe morality as an entirely subjective dimension. In other words, it cannot be pinned down exactly whether behaviors are objectively good or bad. We can only find fault with someone else’s interpretation based on their own unique moral code. Morality is relative to the individual or society.

Yet last night’s dialogue concerning football and human behavior was filled with moral accusations and claims which strongly suggested humans are not content with relativist morality. Indeed, we are at times frightened by and disgusted with what we observe in and around football. Our sense of moral justice is deeply disturbed. But with respect to what exactly?

Recent findings suggest that in responding to the panelist’s questions, I observed a familiar paradigm. Each time I have discussed any aspect of moral behavior, the speculation humans are good or at worst morally neutral animals continually reemerges. This widely accepted presupposition is then followed shortly by disgust at some aspect of human behavior. Almost as if to ask “why are all these good humans behaving so badly?” while ignoring the very real implications of this line of inquiry. A question rendered unanswerable by the insistent a priori assumptions from which it was derived.

In a recent development, if humans are intrinsically beneficent, conscientious, fair, humble, and honest then why is football rife with racism, misogyny, greed, disenfranchisement, lies, cheating, violence, and the hypocrisy to deny the occurrence of any such behaviors except when a rival club is the guilty party? Behaviors which are perpetrated by individual supporters, fanatical groups, club administrations, corporate bodies such as FIFA, political entities, nations, and even the players themselves. No one participating faction is guiltless.

To so blithely sidestep more sufficient explanations for the empirical reality of wickedness in football and in human behavior more generally is not just factually incorrect. It undermines real attempts to understand the root of these behaviors where they might be dealt with more effectively.

To listen to The Moral Maze episode entitled “Football: a moral force for good?” produced by BBC radio and featuring PortuGOAL’s Seleção correspondent Nathan Motz click on this link.

Furthermore, in good faith, how successful is a response against heinous evil when those perpetrating it are regarded as behaving in accord with their unique moral ambitions? Humans refuse to accept their indisputably objective moral lacking at a fundamental level. This restricts us from ever doing any more than “stamping out” the alleged impropriety of others – while we ourselves may readily engage in these very same behaviors. Moral relativism cannot account for the moral outrage emanating from all corners of the football world. Is Qatar wrong to perpetrate human rights atrocities or is it allowable because their culture is indifferent? Is hooliganism objectively wrong, or only when someone else’s club is responsible?

The overlooking of our own failings while lashing out at others for theirs is quintessential to the morally fallen nature of humanity itself. Football tells all. There are not good people and bad people. There are only people who both willfully and unintentionally transgress the moral code embedded in each of our hearts. A moral law which can only have ever been given by a moral Lawgiver. Otherwise, it is truly your word against mine as it pertains to the moral validity of all behaviors - even those which may deeply violate your conscience.

Football generates an episodic, semantic, and imagistic description of universal archetypes: good and evil, sacrifice and greed, cruelty and mercy, hero and anti-hero. It speaks to every arc of life’s plotline: tragedy, comedy, victory, defeat, the finite nature of our circumstances. It is one of the preeminent existential dialects alongside religion, visual art, written and spoken language, music, and theatre. Football plucks a primal chord.

In a recent development, as metaphysics have been curtailed to just physics in the modern secular West, football has only elevated our awareness of the often dire moral predicaments of our species. Yet it is clear the moral conversation does not originate on a football pitch. The pitch is but a grand stage upon which moral themes may be observed and critiqued, a mirror held in front of our own soul.

The desire for ultimate purpose, for meaning beyond the material realm, never disappeared in modernity. Arguably, it has only become more desperate as the outcry for ultimate significance comes under more scrutiny and criticism by those who constrain ontological explanations to those accounted for by physics. The severity of the mental health crisis in the West is in no small part explained by the terrifying existential awareness we are cut adrift in an abstract sea of meaningless, hopeless wandering between two oblivions - that before mortal life began and that at mortal life’s end. Let football be one voice which reassures you - there is ultimate meaning and good reasons why football so unsettles our craving for justice.

Industry observers note that in a palpable, unavoidable way, football and supporter communities across Europe are encountering moral quandaries. In Portugal, age-old debates between FC Porto and Benfica have routinely been haunted by, in many cases, farcical and cynical hypocrisy. Throughout its history, the FPF has been susceptible to showing partiality to a club, player, or style which ultimately degrades the performance of our beloved Seleção. Deny it all we like, and not one aspect of this reality is changed.

In a recent development, in conclusion, whatever your thoughts or beliefs on the subject of moral significance, its origin, the meaning of life, and how football draws that out, I hope it will be beneficial to examine these matters more deeply. In my zeal, I admit I have not always been prudent to initiate these discussions in a way which respects thoughtful disagreement. It is my hope this effort to bring that discussion to Portuguese football will be well-received and carefully pondered. But I will contentedly listen to those followers who may be genuinely unhappy or unsupportive of this or any other idea about which I write.

According to recent reports, the readers of this website and the larger Portuguese football loving world are my people. It is a joy and a responsibility I take seriously whenever I have the opportunity to raise important questions about the Selecao, the game, and our lives in general.

Chelsea's slump in form unpacked: The stars who badly need to step up from Emi Martinez to Cole Palmer, what defensive horror highlights mean for Xabi Alonso's job security - and the players in line to leave in January
